name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted reading server for manga, comics and ebooks with a web reader, metadata, reading progress and multi-user libraries.

alerts.message: The first account registered in the web UI becomes the administrator. Open the app right after deployment and create it.
Kavita has no upload feature: copy your manga, comics and books into the library volume mounted at /manga, then add /manga as a library in the admin settings.
